description: Use when someone asks whether a sofa will fit: through a door, round a hall, up the stairs, and, when room is yes, in the room itself. Applies the furniture shops’ straight, tipped-back, on-end and swing tests, the same opening tests on the stairs, and, only when asked, a wall and walkway check. Grades each ok, tight or no; a walkway under the least main walkway is tight, never no. The two-thirds wall figure is a proportion cue in the notes, not a pass or a fail.

door_width_cm.description: The door’s clear width: the gap with the door open, frame to door edge (cm).

front_used_cm.description: Depth already taken in front of the sofa, such as a coffee table and the gap to it. 0 if nothing sits there yet (cm).

hall_width_cm.description: The width of the hall or landing beyond the door, where the sofa must turn (cm).

room.description: yes to check the room as well (the wall and the walkway in front), no to check only the way in. With no, the room sizes are not used.

room_depth_cm.description: The room’s depth from that wall to the facing wall (used when room is yes) (cm).

route.description: turn if the sofa must turn into the room after the door, straight if it goes straight on.

sofa_depth_cm.description: The sofa’s depth, back to front (cm).

sofa_diagonal_cm.description: The sofa’s diagonal depth: from the back bottom corner to a straight edge laid from the top of the back to the front of the arm (cm).

sofa_height_cm.description: The sofa’s height, floor to the top of the back (cm).

sofa_width_cm.description: The sofa’s width, arm to arm (its length when carried) (cm).

stair_headroom_cm.description: The lowest headroom over the stairs (used when stairs is yes). New stairs in England need at least 200 cm (cm).

stair_width_cm.description: The narrowest clear width of the stairs (used when stairs is yes) (cm).

stairs.description: yes if the sofa has to go up or down stairs, no if it does not.

wall_cm.description: The length of the wall the sofa stands against (used when room is yes) (cm).

name: sofa_fit

checks.description: Each test: straight, tipped, on_end and swing, and wall and walkway when room is yes, each with clear_cm and grade

door.description: The better way through the door: how (straight or tipped), clear_cm (to spare; negative: too big), grade

end_across.description: Which side goes across: depth or height

end_across_cm.description: The sofa’s end across the door

margin_cm.description: Under this much to spare is tight

room.description: The room, null when room is no: verdict, wall_clear_cm, wall_grade, wall_share (sofa width ÷ wall), walkway_clear_cm (left in front, minus the least walkway), walkway_grade, walkway_least_cm

size_varies_pct.description: How far sofas vary from their listed size

stairs.description: The stairs: how (straight, tipped or none), clear_cm (null when there are no stairs), grade

turn.description: The better way to turn after it: how (end, swing or none), clear_cm (null with none), grade

verdict.description: ok, tight or no, for the way in, the stairs and the room together
